g.data-latex: \begin{equation} \begin{pmatrix} 2(x_1-x_0) & 2(y_1-y_0) \cr 2(x_2-x_1) & 2(y_2-y_1) \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} c_x \cr c_y \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} x_1^2-x_0^2+y_1^2-y_0^2 \cr x_2^2-x_1^2+y_2^2-y_1^2 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad r=\|P_1-C\|. \end{equation} Thus, we obtain the required center and radius.
